name: Skins
description: Change your skin in game without restarting. The skins come from the Vibe Launcher's skin library.

notice.noLauncher: Only available when you start the game from the Vibe Launcher.
notice.noList: The launcher hasn't sent a skin list yet. Update the Vibe Launcher and restart the game.

screen.title: Skins
screen.subtitle: Click a skin to wear it right away.
screen.account: Account: {0} · Click a skin to wear it right away.
screen.noLauncher: Changing your skin in game only works when you start the game from the Vibe Launcher.
screen.noList: The launcher hasn't sent a skin list yet. Update the Vibe Launcher and restart the game.
screen.wrongAccount: The skin list belongs to a different account than the one you're playing with. Restart the game from the launcher with the right account.
screen.empty: Your skin library is empty. Add a skin in the launcher under "Skins" – it shows up here by itself.
screen.cannot.offline_account: You can't change the skin of an offline account. Sign in with your Microsoft account in the launcher.
screen.cannot.no_account: No account is signed in to the launcher.
screen.cannot.signed_out: Your launcher sign-in has expired. Sign in there again and it works again.
screen.cannot.other: The launcher can't change your skin right now.
screen.done: Changed. Others see it when you rejoin the server.
screen.hint: The change goes through your Minecraft account and applies everywhere.

toast.done.body: Other players see it when you rejoin the server.

error.no_answer: The launcher doesn't answer. Is it still running?
error.timeout: That took too long. Try again in a moment.
error.offline_account: That doesn't work with an offline account.
error.no_account: No account is signed in to the launcher.
error.signed_out: Your launcher sign-in has expired. Sign in there again.
error.not_found: This skin isn't in the library any more.
error.rate_limited: Minecraft doesn't allow another change right now. Wait a minute.
error.network: No connection to Minecraft. Check your internet.
error.busy: The launcher is still busy with another change.
error.io: The request to the launcher couldn't be saved.
